# Inventory investigation — SKU-101
Synthetic data only | Read-only training exercise

Item: Bearing housing | Bin: A-01
System: 120 | Physical: 116 | Variance: -4
Value variance: GBP -34.00

Evidence: Recent transfer; destination receipt not yet reconciled
Hypothesis: Unreconciled transfer may explain the shortage.
Conclusion: Unverified hypothesis; do not adjust stock automatically.

## Recommended procedures
### SOP-01 — Independent recount
- Check SKU and bin labels.
- Recount using a second operator.
- Record quantity, time and evidence.
### SOP-02 — Transaction reconciliation
- Review recent receipts, picks and transfers.
- Compare physical movement against system postings.
- Check open or duplicate transactions.
### SOP-03 — Escalation and adjustment
- Escalate unresolved variances to inventory control.
- Obtain authorised approval before adjusting stock.
- Record the reason and retain the audit trail.
